display_name: Solana PDA Bump and ATA Audit
description: Audit of a claimed program-derived-address tuple (program id, seeds with declared encodings, bump, claimed address), pasted values only, plus Token-2022-correct associated-token-account derivation. Primary text pinned at claim: solana-labs/solana at commit 7700cb3128c1f19820de67b81aa45d18f73d2ac0, sdk/program/src/pubkey.rs (create_program_address and try_find_program_address), with the successor SDK cross-checked at anza-xyz/solana-sdk commit 021fd2f1864ab194b53498bb03c21ad1dc124b8d, address/src/derive.rs. The node recomputes the address the runtime rules yield for the claimed bump (SHA-256 over the seeds, the bump byte, the program id and the marker string ProgramDerivedAddress), tests whether the derived bytes decompress to an Ed25519 curve point (such a hash can never be a program-derived address), scans the canonical bump search space 255 down to 1 that the pinned client implementation uses, and reports whether the claimed bump is canonical and the claimed address matches. A second valid address at a non-canonical bump for the same seeds is the substitution class the node exposes as a fact: free SDK one-liners derive one address and stay silent about the other. When the optional wallet, mint and token-program triple is pasted, the node derives the associated token account under the declared token program and under the classic Token program side by side (seeds [wallet, token program id, mint] under program ATokenGPvbdGVxr1b2hvZbsiqW5xWH25efTNsLJA8knL, pinned at solana-program/associated-token-account commit 4004274dfb861e09570af873b46cb0b0919e8df0), so a derivation that used the classic program for a Token-2022 mint (TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb) is visible as the two addresses differing; the pinned ATA source itself deprecates the classic-only helper for Token-2022 mints. Seed limits (at most 16 seeds including the bump, each seed at most 32 bytes) are reported as facts, never silently dropped. Values only, no wording about risk or intent. Zero network, zero RPC, nothing on-chain is read.
deadline_note: No regulatory deadline: this node audits pasted address-derivation values, it does not carry a dated obligation.
cycle_preflight: SLOW - 98,408,489 user_cycles max across all 16 fixture vectors, measured exec-only 2026-11-03 (DEFERRED-PROVE-BATCH-6); under the 600,000,000 batch cap, booked per Tim's 2026-08-29 GPU-is-used ruling with the singleton idle.

output.note: Derivation per the pinned Solana sources: SHA-256 over seeds (declared order) then the bump byte then the program id then the bytes "ProgramDerivedAddress" (solana-labs/solana sdk/program/src/pubkey.rs at 7700cb3128c1f19820de67b81aa45d18f73d2ac0, create_program_address L585-L616); a result that decompresses to an Ed25519 curve point can never be a program-derived address, reported as on_curve. The canonical bump scan follows try_find_program_address (L510-L545) and its successor (anza-xyz/solana-sdk address/src/derive.rs): candidate bumps run 255 down to 1 and the first off-curve result wins, so bump 0 is outside the search space and a claimed bump of 0 is non-canonical even when its recomputed address matches; the row gloss that said 255 to 0 is corrected here per the primary text. Limits: at most 16 seeds including the bump seed, each seed at most 32 bytes (MAX_SEEDS 16, MAX_SEED_LEN 32), restated as facts, never silently dropped. ATA derivation uses seeds [wallet, token program id, mint] under program ATokenGPvbdGVxr1b2hvZbsiqW5xWH25efTNsLJA8knL (solana-program/associated-token-account at 4004274dfb861e09570af873b46cb0b0919e8df0, interface/src/address.rs L67-L74); the classic-program side by side uses TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA, and token_program_mismatch is true exactly when the mint is declared under Token-2022 (TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb, spl-token-2022-interface 3.1.2 src/lib.rs L29) and the two addresses differ, the wrong-derivation class the pinned ATA source itself deprecates. Off-curve testing is @noble/curves ed25519 point decompression. All comparisons are string equality on pasted values; this kernel reads nothing on-chain.
